description: HS 748 Srs 2 (c/n 1552) transport displayed at the entrance of Base Aérea do Galeão (Ala 11); listed in ABRAPAC 2019 and AeroEntusiasta Feb 2026 compilations. A vertical fin of KC-137 2404 is also preserved in front of the 2º/2º GT inside the base (not an airframe, not recorded).
